note: Governor statue (slot 1, plaza centre) — pose as DATA so each episode can swap it (running gag): spec `statuePose: '<name>'` (default `default`). R6 units (torso 2×2×1, limbs 1×2×1, head 1.2), figure faces +z (south, down the Grand Stair). Limb `dir` = unit-ish vector from the shoulder / hip pivot to the hand / foot (normalised in code); `head`/`torso` = [pitch, yaw, roll] degrees; `megaphone` = [from (mouth), to] in figure units or null; `point` = index finger on that hand. Plaque text is in-world (a motto, never a name label).
